claims.text: The William Vale is just steps from McCarren Park and the East River, in the center of Williamsburg, which the hotel calls Brooklyn's most creative neighborhood.

findings.quote: Just steps from McCarren Park and the East River, The William Vale is in the center of Brooklyn’s most creative neighborhood
The Heart of Williamsburg

claims.text: The L and G trains are a few blocks away, one stop from Manhattan.

findings.quote: with the L and G trains just a few blocks away, you’re one stop from Manhattan

claims.text: The hotel takes its name from a 19th-century Brooklynite whose property boundaries encircled the site.

findings.quote: The William Vale derived its name from a 19th-century Brooklynite whose property boundaries encircled the location of the development.

claims.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows, luxury linens and design-forward furnishings.

findings.quote: all of our rooms and suites offer private balconies with stunning views of Manhattan and Williamsburg, as well as floor-to-ceiling windows, luxury linens, and design-forward furnishings.

claims.text: Room designs are sleek and modern, with pops of color sourced from local Brooklyn artists.

findings.quote: The room designs are sleek and modern, warmed with a few random pops of color sourced from local Brooklyn artists.

claims.text: Suites include the Junior King Suite, the Manhattan View Corner Suite, the King One Bedroom Suite and the Vale Garden Residence.

findings.quote: including the Junior King Suite, Manhattan View Corner Suite, King One Bedroom Suite, and Vale Garden Residence

claims.text: The outdoor pool has poolside cabanas, daybeds and lounge chairs.

findings.quote: Get some sun at the poolside cabanas, daybeds, or lounge chairs

claims.text: The fitness center is open 24/7.

findings.quote: Elevate your wellness journey at our 24/7 state-of-the-art fitness center.

claims.text: Williamsburg Beauty Spa, a family-owned neighborhood spa, is known for customized facials.

findings.quote: This family-owned neighborhood favorite is known for customized facials and results-driven treatments

claims.text: Guests can use The Malin Williamsburg coworking space with a day pass or meeting room booking at an exclusive rate.

findings.quote: Guests of The William Vale can access The Malin Williamsburg with a Day Pass, Multi Day Pass, or private meeting room booking at an exclusive rate

claims.text: Leuca serves Southern Italian food with handmade pasta and wood-fired pizza.

findings.quote: Leuca brings the bold flavors of Southern Italy to Williamsburg with handmade pasta, wood-fired pizza

claims.text: The rooftop bar Westlight is on the 22nd floor.

findings.quote: Perched atop the 22nd floor of The William Vale

claims.text: All guest rooms and suites have private balconies over Brooklyn and the Manhattan skyline.

findings.quote: All guest rooms and suites feature private balconies, offering open-air vantage points over Brooklyn and the Manhattan skyline.

claims.text: The Manhattan View Corner Suite has a wraparound balcony.

findings.quote: Manhattan View Corner Suite Wraparound Balcony

claims.text: Vale Park is an elevated green space with 15,000 square feet of landscaped gardens, open lawns and skyline views.

findings.quote: Vale Park, our elevated green space featuring 15,000 square feet of landscaped gardens, open lawns, and skyline views

claims.text: In the colder months, Winter Spa offers private panoramic barrel saunas and deep-soaking hot tubs.

findings.quote: Immerse yourself in a unique wellness experience featuring private panoramic barrel saunas and deep-soaking hot tubs.
wellness-focused offerings at Winter Spa during the colder months

claims.text: Westlight offers 360-degree views over the Manhattan skyline, the East River and Williamsburg.

findings.quote: Offering 360-degree views overlooking Manhattan skyline, the East River, and the Williamsburg

claims.text: Vale Pool is a summer amenity and Winter Spa a cold-season one, so each is closed outside its season.

findings.quote: from summer programming at Vale Pool to wellness-focused offerings at Winter Spa during the colder months
Closed for Season

claims.text: Westlight, Leuca, Little Fino and Vale Park welcome locals as well as hotel guests, and Vale Pool may offer public day passes in select seasons.

findings.quote: Westlight, Leuca, Little Fino, and Vale Park welcome both locals and travelers, while Vale Pool may offer public access through day passes during select seasons.

claims.text: Pets are welcome, but a cleaning fee is added if a pet enters the room.

findings.quote: The William Vale welcomes pets. A $50 cleaning fee will be added to your stay if a pet enters your hotel room.
